prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Redesign Pet Selection Grid with Animated Previews: Redesign the friend selection screen into an interactive stage layout with animated pet previews and sound effects so users can sample pets before committing. (why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 60.9% and a median time of 89s, showing users hesitate or get stuck when selecting their pet.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Defer Account Sign-In After Pet Selection: Reorder the flow to move sign_in after pet adoption so users pick their desktop pet before creating an account. (why: Early sign_in has a 72.9% conversion rate and support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after re-logging in.)
2: [finish, redesign] Redesign Home Intro with Interactive Desktop Checklist: Rebuild the home intro screen into a checklist layout with action buttons testing desktop visibility and hotkeys. (why: The finish step drops to 64.8% conversion and post-onboarding support is filled with confusion regarding desktop pet controls.)
3: [adoption, wait_info] Custom Pet Generation Status Indicator: Display real-time generation progress and time estimates during photo upload and adoption certificate creation. (why: Adoption has the lowest step conversion at 60.9% and users report custom pet creation failing without clear feedback (3 emails).)
4: [home, hint] Desktop Display Overlay Troubleshooter Hint: Add an explicit overlay hint and interactive test button on the waiting screen for multi-monitor display issues. (why: 3 emails reported pets not appearing on the desktop or the app failing to render over existing windows.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Spotlight Layout for Path Selection: Switch choose_path layout to spotlight card style featuring prominent feature callouts and estimated setup times. (why: choose_path drops to 76.2% conversion with a very long mean time of 514s due to unclear path differences.)

scores.note: Adoption loses the most users (39.1%), but complex UI redesign with animations requires a full release.
Supported by 8 emails and strong UX patterns of deferring account creation to reduce early drop-off.
Finish step drops 35.2% and support notes confusion, but building interactive checklist screens is high cost.
Targets highest drop-off step with direct support mail evidence; status feedback reliably increases completion.
Home step has lower overall drop-off (18.7%), making overall funnel impact more modest despite clear support tickets.
High mean time (514s) indicates hesitation; spotlight layout should clarify choices and improve conversion.
